hero.title: Hello! I am Libní Gonzaléz
hero.intro: I am a clinical psychologist and graduate of Universidad Mariano Gálvez de Guatemala. I offer professionally guaranteed care, authorized by the Guatemalan College of Psychologists. I have academic training and accreditations in Neuropsychology.
hero.therapy: In my practice, you will find psychological counseling and therapy for a variety of psychological difficulties and problems.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Psychological Counseling and Therapy - Online
services.intro: To help you overcome your difficulties and achieve a fuller, more satisfying life, we will create a personalized treatment adapted to your needs, always based on trust, respect, and confidentiality.
services.method: In my professional practice, I use an integrative approach that maximizes the effectiveness of therapy and adapts each intervention to the needs and individual characteristics of every case.

about.title: About me
about.background: I consider myself a person who is always seeking knowledge and is passionate about understanding how different disciplines work. I have a deep interest in science and art, which regularly leads me to take part in activities that bring both fields together.
about.interest: My main interest in psychology has always been the deep understanding and effective treatment of different psychological problems and disorders.

contact.title: Shall we schedule an appointment?
footer: From anywhere and from the comfort of your home, we can begin online therapy.
